punchline: Sarah's right-hand employee did the books, the baking and the hiring for two years, then quit with one 7 a.m. phone call.
thirty_sec: Six months into her pie shop, Sarah hired Elizabeth, who soon did everything: books, baking, cleaning, hiring and training three people. One Wednesday at seven in the morning Elizabeth phoned. New job, better pay, sorry. Her hires drifted off and Sarah went back to doing it all herself. Michael Gerber calls it management by abdication: Sarah handed the job over without ever defining it.
